answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article published 2026-07-01 reporting an NN, Inc. announcement made in late June 2026; the original NN statement date is not stated in the record.
answer.note: For NVDA, this is a supplier-side lead, not a disclosed NVIDIA purchase. NN, Inc. reported (via Yahoo Finance, 2026-07-01) that it is adding 47 machine centers for liquid cooling production at its Wuxi, China plant for NVIDIA AI data center racks, with 100% of the new capacity already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and it targets US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026. If the awards are tied to NVIDIA rack programs, this points to growing outsourced liquid cooling capacity in NVIDIA's Asian rack supply chain during 2026. The NVIDIA link is an inference: the quoted facts remain true if the awards come from other rack or system builders using NVIDIA-compatible designs, so NVIDIA as direct buyer is an unconfirmed hypothesis. The US$80-90 million figure is NN's own business target, not a measure of NVIDIA purchases. The NN narrative revenue and earnings projections (US$485.5 million and US$47.9 million by 2028; an unnamed-analyst estimate of about US$489.5 million and US$48.3 million) are third-party or rumoured estimates about NN and carry no NVIDIA-specific information. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal concerns NN's equity and has no bearing on NVDA.
limitations: The customers behind NN's pre-sold awards are not named in the record, so NVIDIA's direct purchase role is unknown rather than confirmed.
The record gives no statement date for NN's announcement (original_day is empty); the only dated item is the 2026-07-01 publication date, and event timing is only 'late June 2026'.
The 100% pre-sold claim and the US$80-90 million 2026 target are NN party statements relayed by a media summary; no contract values, award terms, or customer confirmation are disclosed.
The 47 machine centers' capacity in units, the start date of production, and the share of Wuxi output tied to NVIDIA-related racks are not disclosed.
The NN revenue and earnings projections are a narrative and unnamed-analyst estimates for NN, not NVIDIA forecasts, and cannot be used for NVDA quantities.
The record contains no NVIDIA statement, filing, or partner announcement confirming the NN relationship.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K to confirm the announcement date, the 47-machine-center detail, and whether NVIDIA or a named rack builder is identified as the award source.
Check NVIDIA's latest 10-K/10-Q supplier or concentration disclosures and any NVIDIA partner or MGX-ecosystem announcements naming NN or Wuxi-based liquid cooling production.
Check other liquid cooling suppliers' 2026 disclosures for similar NVIDIA-linked capacity pre-sales to test whether the NN capacity is part of a broader industry pattern.
Track NN's subsequent quarterly filings for disclosed customer concentration, award values, and actual Wuxi liquid cooling revenue against the US$80-90 million target.
